estimator.dstar_late_epochs: per run: gain = min(val_metric, epochs 0-199) - min(val_metric, all epochs); late best = 0-based best_epoch >= 200
estimator.dstar_neighbours: trials of the D* study (trials_v2_D) within 0.001 / 0.005 eV of the best validation MAE; inside shared = dropout in [0, 0.3] and weight decay in [1e-6, 1e-3]
estimator.gpu_classes: class = payload.hardware.gpu_model; single-run gap per (r, seed) = test site MAE of S minus that of D* on the same test sites; mean over pairs
estimator.s_cap_tail: capped = epochs_run == max_epochs; gain = min(val_metric, epochs 0 to max - 31) - min(val_metric, all epochs); lr fraction = lr of the last history epoch / lr of epoch 0
estimator.s_optima: selected trial = minimum validation MAE of the 30-trial study; position = (x - low) / (high - low) for dropout, log(x / low) / log(high / low) for weight decay and learning rate; interior = position in [0.05, 0.95]; capped trial = epochs_run == max_epochs (200)

cross_class_max_abs_ensemble_mae_shift.definition: max over payload.ensemble (pass1) of |ensemble_mae_minus_ref|: seed-ensemble MAE of the repeat on an NRP class minus that of the original runs (ref_run_id; their records carry no hardware block, so their GPU class is unrecorded)

single_run_gap_S_minus_Dstar.definition: per (r, seed) at 654 hosts: test site MAE of the single S run minus that of the single D* run of the same cell (same test sites); classes from payload.hardware.gpu_model

payload.label: tuning and training asymmetry between S and D* (search space, epoch limit, capped runs) and GPU classes of the 654-host headline runs

history.max_abs_min_val_minus_best_val_m.stored_at: run records payload.best_val_metric vs min of payload.history val_metric

payload.sign_convention: gains are validation MAE decreases in eV (positive = later epochs lowered the validation error); gaps to best are validation MAE above the best trial (positive); single-run gaps are MAE_S - MAE_D* (positive = D* more accurate)
